text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian-Omani summit in Aqaba on Saturday.
- Saudi delegation visits agricultural areas in Jordan Valley; a list of goods to be exported to be announced via official channels.
- Stock prices to rise gradually after a series of economic measures to boost private sector investment.
- Transport minister says he plans to restructure transport sector on new basis.
- Customs chief to meet private sector to explain new customs law.
